title: chore(examples): update Expo to v57
body:
## 🎯 Changes

We've fallen multiple versions behind. It still works after simply running the upgrade command. Importantly, look at the lockfile improvements! More culling to come...

- Expo 53: https://expo.dev/changelog/sdk-53
- Expo 54: https://expo.dev/changelog/sdk-54
- Expo 55: https://expo.dev/changelog/sdk-55
- Expo 56: https://expo.dev/changelog/sdk-56
- Expo 57: https://expo.dev/changelog/sdk-57
